🏨 ROSEWOOD HOTEL [HORROR]

You just got a new job as the night clerk at an old roadside hotel.
The pay is decent. The guests are... strange. 
Can you survive all 3 nights?

👥 Play alone or with friends ( 1 - 4 )
🎬 5 different endings. Can you find them all?
🗝️ Earn keys to unlock skins, flashlights and light colors

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game to support new updates!
